english.note: Use this when the increase involves spreading across an area, especially for problems, disease, fire, or bad habits.
Use this when something gradually spreads across an area, such as shadows, fire, or disease.

examples.english: This bad habit can proliferate quickly from person to person.
examples.traditional: 呢種壞習慣一傳十、十傳百，好快就蔓延開去。
